decomposition.residual_is_reported_not_gated: (P-E)+(W-P)+(att-W)-(att-E) cancels P and W identically, so the residual is an algebraic tautology: measured in float64, moving P by 1e-9 leaves it at 0.0 and moving P by 100 leaves it at 4.44e-15. The power is in the second route above.

reproduction.detection_floor: one float32 ulp of the stored value

role: measures both ATT definitions on both backends, each under one per-second instrument; proposes the freeze and rules nothing
what_this_does_not_say: It does not decide whether E_sumo or the env metric is primary on SUMO: Rule R is a CityFlow gate with no SUMO counterpart and the amendment is the coordinator's.
It does not compare raw travel times across backends; every cross-backend statement is about rho (PREREGISTRATION section 3.4).
A reproduction difference below one float32 ulp is invisible to the reproduction check, because output/p7_0 stores att_per_step as float32.
